ask.placeholder: e.g. Which AI initiatives should we kill, and why?
ask.contract: Every answer is read from the loaded enterprise context and cited to its source — and says so honestly when the evidence isn't there.

suggestedQuestions: Tell me about our clinical, claims, data, and automation-readiness landscape.
Summarize the business and technology landscape with volumetrics.
What is blocking value, AI scale, or modernization?
How do we compare to peers and what moves should follow?

signals.headline: Clinical + claims unification is the foundation, not a side project.
signals.body: Longitudinal patient/member views require Epic, claims, pharmacy, and CRM records to be harmonized with PHI-safe governance and certified semantic products.

move.title: Approve guarded pilot for Databricks AWS clinical + claims lakehouse foundation

signals.headline: Prior authorization AI must prove policy evidence and auditability.
signals.body: Automation should not scale from workflow enthusiasm alone; it needs medical policy evidence, denial rationale, appeal support, and utilization management ownership.

move.title: Close evidence gap for Unified semantic layer for automation-ready data products

signals.headline: Call-center agent assist needs operational context, not transcripts alone.
signals.body: Useful next-best-action depends on benefits, claims status, care gaps, provider network, pharmacy, and consent controls.

move.title: Sequence dependency before scaling Prior authorization automation evidence cockpit

signals.headline: Payment integrity value depends on closing the feedback loop.
signals.body: FWA and leakage analytics need provider-pattern evidence, recovery outcomes, and false-positive control before finance can claim value.

move.title: Approve guarded pilot for Databricks AWS clinical + claims lakehouse foundation

signals.headline: M365 Copilot non-clinical adoption has $93M committed and $2.5M realized.
signals.body: Owned by Chief Data Officer at stage 'scale' (confidence medium); blocker: PHI/model governance and source evidence missing.

move.title: Gate scale of M365 Copilot non-clinical adoption on measured value

signals.headline: On its core modernization metrics the enterprise sits in the third quartile — a 29-point gap to top quartile.
signals.body: Your value 36.4 vs industry median 60 and top quartile 74 (large enterprise peer group).
